verdict.rationale: LiveKit is an agent-building platform, so connecting to MCP servers as a client is a fair question for it. The pack contains no evidence that LiveKit agents can connect to external MCP servers. The only MCP evidence (livekit-docs-37) is LiveKit's own docs MCP server, which serves coding agents; that is server-side and does not count here. Agent Builder's generic "tool configuration" is an adjacent feature, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
